errors_and_improvements.root_cause: CPython json.loads accepts lone escaped UTF-16 surrogate codepoints but native safetensors 0.7.0 rejects their headers, so a prior local probe could return LOCAL_FILES_PRESENT_ONLY for unreadable weights.
errors_and_improvements.lesson_applied: R07 errata showed that escaped literal tests can falsely PASS. Use chr(0xD800)/chr(0xDFFF) for real decoded invalid codepoints, JSON ensure_ascii=True for literal on-disk escapes, and positive emoji surrogate-pair cases. Independently cross-check against native safetensors parser.
